propositions: reopen transitions a closed child to open but does not cascade to reopen its closed parent(s), leaving an invalid state (closed parent with open child)
the close-time guard blocks closing a parent with open children but has no counterpart on reopen, allowing the asymmetric invalid state
the existing _cascade_open_parent helper is hardcoded for open->in_progress and fires only on that edge, missing closed->open

generalizing the cascade seam to an edge table (_CASCADING_EDGES) driven by (current_status, target_status) pairs unifies both edges under one implementation with shared error handling and cycle guards
the cascade decision reads parent status without the write lock, creating a TOCTOU window where a peer can move the parent; the fix adds a benign-race re-check matching claim_compute's behavior
